payload.comment: Preprocessing-stage artefacts are internally consistent. All split totals (89996/10004/7180 = 107180) reconcile with samples_profiled and official PathMNIST sizes. Train imbalance ratio 1.633908 = 12885/7886 verified. Provenance chain (MD5, per-split SHA-256, Zenodo DOI) is complete. Domain-shift and class-distribution risks for the external test set (CRC-VAL-HE-7K) are correctly characterised as dataset limitations, not pipeline defects. Two minor observations: (1) the LLM identifier 'qwen3.8' is non-standard for a Qwen release—confirm the Ollama tag resolves to the intended base model to rule out silent fallback; (2) the narrative risk text cites test-set max/min ≈ 3.64, but 1338/339 ≈ 3.95; the qualitative conclusion (more than double train imbalance) still holds, so this is a cosmetic,
